The bug was in `in_ready`: it only blocked a closing beat when the accumulator was full (`count == 3`), but didn't account for `in_last`. That meant a last-beat with `count != 3` could be accepted while the output register held an undelivered word, overwriting it and dropping bytes. Fixed by adding `&& !in_last` to the non-closing fallback condition.

The design is now fixed and all tests in `tb_visible.v` pass (`TEST PASSED`).
